_comment: Behavython CLI config. Copy this file, remove _comment keys, and fill in your values.
_input_folder_comment: Folder containing all animal files. The pipeline auto-discovers and groups them by animal ID.
_input_files_comment: Advanced: explicit file list. Only use if your folder layout is non-standard. Ignored when input_folder is set.
_config_path_comment: Required for open_field / elevated_plus_maze if animals lack individual config JSONs. Set to null otherwise.
_trim_amount_comment: Seconds to skip at the start of the recording.
_crop_video_comment: If true, only the window [trim_amount, trim_amount + task_duration] is analyzed.
